Because the three-dimensional surface formed by the special structure of the multi-layer coating surface is conducive to the bonding of the coating, it is not subject to the combined stress of the thin film, and the adhesion is strong. The coating has high hardness, strong adhesion, and can be used in high-temperature environments. In the coating structure, the multi-layer coating can be fixed on the substrate, and the multi-layer coating can be used to produce multi-layer materials. From the perspective of multi-functional components, electromagnetic and other products have advantages.

Multi-layer coating has many forms and can be used for various purposes. Ablation, sputtering, ion beam sputtering, chemical vapor deposition, and other methods can be used. By changing the composition and structure of the coating, the function can be changed. The coating can be rotated through different angles to achieve different functions, and the coating can be used to control the coating structure of the new product.

In modern electronics, a large number of multi-layer coating processes are used, such as vacuum, sputtering, chemical vapor deposition, and other methods to prepare multi-layer coatings.
(1) In₂O₃/Y₂O₃/ZnS·Mn/Y₂O₃ multi-layer composite coating

Y₂O₃ high-voltage insulating layer, then covered with a small amount of Mn and ZnS luminescent layer about 500nm thick. The coating is used as a light-emitting layer. The thickness is about 1-layer thickness or can be used as a single-layer insulating layer. The voltage is applied to the surface of the electrode, and the 3-5 million-hour long-term reliability can be achieved.
(2) Al₂O₃/ZnS·Mn/Al₂O₃ three-layer composite coating
The sample has a double insulating layer structure. The upper layer uses a thin layer of ZnS·Mn and the lower layer uses Al₂O₃. The surface light emission efficiency is greatly improved. (3) Al₂O₃/NiO/ZrO₂/Ni/Al₂O₃/LaCoO₃ seven-layer composite coating
To meet the functional requirements of multi-layer coating, such as a room-temperature solid electrolyte fuel cell using a layer, flat structure, (1) Al₂O₃ gas layer; (2) NiO gas electrode layer; (3) ZrO₂ layer; (4) Ni/Al electrolyte layer; (5) Al₂O₃ gas protection layer; (6) Cu layer; (7) LaCoO₃ air electrode

sections.text: 1. Laser cladding of composite coatings with special properties: (1) Ni-Cr-B-Si (base) + Ni (WC) - is a laser cladding coating used for wear resistance. Using laser cladding technology on automotive engine cylinder blocks to reduce the return rate, obtain high-quality coatings. The laser cladding process uses Ni-Cr-B-Si as the base alloy, adding 50% or more tungsten carbide - Ni (WC) ceramic as a hard phase, through laser heating and coating treatment, and then using laser to heat the coating, giving the iron-clad coating a certain hardness and wear resistance. The coating structure is divided into two layers: the upper layer has WC particles distributed in the coating, and the lower layer has a uniform distribution of WC particles. The coating hardness can reach 6 times higher.

2) 20Ni4Mo (base) + NiCo (WC - particle size 450-900μm, containing 60% laser cladding coarse particles) WC composite layer has continuous wear resistance, and the hardness is higher than the machine tool. The coating structure is divided into two layers: the upper layer is WC particles with lower hardness and lower hardness, and the lower layer is WC particles with lower hardness and lower hardness. This composite coating WC coating has good wear resistance and is suitable for industrial applications.
3) 15MnV (base) + Ni (WC) laser cladding coating layer, hardness up to 1090-1150HV, wear resistance is higher than base material hardness 2 times above.
4) 60 copper (base material) + (WC) laser cladding coating layer, hardness up to 2200HV or above, coating material hardness 60 times higher.
5) Tungsten carbide + NiCrSiB self-fluxing alloy laser cladding coating layer hardness base material 4-5 times.

6) Ni-Al-Cr-H alloy powder laser cladding with Rene-80 alloy to perform laser cladding, can significantly improve the high temperature oxidation resistance at 1200°C; Inconel800 alloy surface laser coating Ni-Cr-Al-Zr-Y coating, greatly improve the base material high temperature oxidation resistance.

sections.text: Ni-Cu-P/MoS₂ Composite Coating Layer

The electroplated Ni-Cu-P/MoS₂ composite coating layer is a kind of electroplated composite coating layer, composed of Ni:57.6% (mass fraction, below), Cu:11.2%, P:3.2%, MoS₂:28% (correct coating composition obtained). Its friction coefficient is lower than Ni-P/MoS₂, and it has a certain amount of copper in the coating, which contains Ni₁P₃, Ni₁₂P₅ and other phases. The coating will contain MoS₂ in the solution, which is easy to obtain crystallization and reduce friction coefficient. If rare earth Ce³⁺ is added, it can inhibit the MoS₂ oxidation and increase the friction coefficient of the coating. The electroplated Ni-Cu-P/MoS₂ coating can be used for oil-free bearing (self-lubricating bearing) and other applications, with the coating on the top and the substrate below.

sections.text: Chapter 1 Material Selection and Surface Treatment Technology
MoS₂-Au Coating

On 1Cr18Ni9Ti substrate, MoS₂-Au coating was deposited by magnetron sputtering. Compared with pure MoS₂ coating, the friction coefficient decreased significantly, and the wear rate increased. The coating thickness was 0.4μm. When the friction coefficient was 1.0-2.0%, the wear rate was 2.0-2.5μm, and the friction coefficient was 30-90 thousand cycles. sections.text: 2. Epoxy resin coating and glass fiber reinforced plastic composite thermal insulation layer

This coating construction method is used, the substrate is coated with epoxy resin primer (Beijing Fangbang Coating Technology Co., Ltd. product). The coating is applied in two layers with a total thickness of 150-200 μm. After the primer is cured, a glass fiber reinforced plastic composite thermal insulation layer is applied. The construction method is as follows: the mold is laid flat, and the epoxy resin adhesive is applied to the mold surface. The glass fiber cloth is laid on the adhesive surface, and the epoxy resin adhesive is applied again. The glass fiber cloth is laid again, and the process is repeated until the required thickness is reached. After the adhesive is cured, the composite layer is removed from the mold and attached to the substrate with epoxy resin adhesive. The outer surface is smoothed and naturally dried.

This construction method is simple and convenient. The specifications of SY/T 0447 require strong adhesion and high shear strength. It is suitable for buried pipelines and underground pipelines (water), ground temperature, gas, oil and water, hot water pipes, and external insulation. It is also suitable for steel pipe storage tank bottom insulation, soil structure insulation.

The protective mechanism of metal-non-metal composite coating layer is based on the fact that the metal coating layer is sealed on the surface of the base material, and the non-metal coating layer is sealed on the outer surface of the metal coating layer, forming a multi-layer sealed structure. If the coating is damaged and the metal coating layer is exposed, the metal coating layer can still provide protection. If the metal coating layer is also damaged, the non-metal coating layer can still provide protection. The metal-non-metal composite coating layer protection is a comprehensive protection method. Different surface treatment techniques produce different coating thicknesses (or modified layer) thicknesses, and the thickness affects the service life of the workpiece. The thickness of the coating should meet the requirements of the workpiece and the process. For example, if a large amount of wear is expected on the surface of the workpiece, the coating thickness should be increased accordingly; if the workpiece is subjected to cyclic stress, the coating thickness should be considered according to the stress concentration factor; the coating thickness should meet the requirements of 1-7-69, 1-7-70

Select surface treatment technology according to the workpiece size and performance requirements. If high-temperature processes such as high-frequency induction hardening (1000°C or higher), CVD (800-1200°C), etc. are used, the workpiece may be deformed; the process group or heat treatment may cause changes in material properties; some low-temperature processes can reduce the hydrogen embrittlement of low-carbon steel materials; some processes can prevent corrosion

Consider the feasibility of surface treatment technology. If the workpiece is large, the equipment may not be able to accommodate it; the subsequent heat treatment sequence should be implemented according to the requirements

sections.text: 1. Selection of coating and workpiece matching

1) When selecting the coating for the surface, the matching with the substrate material must be considered. Many materials have different thermal expansion coefficients when the substrate is different. When the temperature changes, the mismatch between the thermal expansion coefficients will cause the coating to peel off. In the case of thermal expansion mismatch, the coating surface will show signs of peeling on one side, and the material will show signs of warping on the other side. When comparing materials, single-phase materials should be compared with single-phase materials, and multi-phase materials should be compared with multi-phase materials (related to the crystal structure and chemical composition). Compare the smaller material with the larger material; in the case of matching, the substrate should be selected to use the coating layer (generally not suitable for use in high-temperature applications), and the coating should be selected to be used in the coating application below the substrate. 2) In matching, the substrate should be selected to match the coating of the shaft surface, and the workpiece should have a lower coefficient of thermal expansion than the coating. 3) Requirements for corrosion resistance, high temperature resistance and other properties of the workpiece surface should have good comprehensive performance of the coating, due to the limitation of the coating technology, the design or selection of the coating should be combined with the coating technology. If the coating is a composite coating, the coating method should be used for protection and maintenance for more than 10 times the service life

4) Different layers have different coating thickness ratios of 5%-20%, because of its brittleness, use a general oil film cleaning method, but the coating should be strictly controlled to the surface must be post-processed

Silicon nitride ceramic coating with silicon nitride as the main component, MoS₂ and iron oxide as the lubricating agent, water-based binder as the binder, named SS-2 dry film. sections.text: (1) Application of Ceramic Coatings at Low Temperatures

Due to the fact that the friction coefficient of the coating varies with temperature within a certain range, and the friction coefficient is relatively stable, the application of ceramic coatings in low-temperature environments is limited. At temperatures below -200°C, extreme low-temperature friction and wear resistance of 1000°C high-temperature coatings cannot be guaranteed. For example, in aircraft engines (including high-speed rotating machinery) and high-temperature bearing parts, remote-controlled bearings, heat-treated tools, precision machinery, and high-temperature bearing seals, the friction and wear resistance of the coating at low temperatures is a key factor in the application.
(2) Application of Ceramic Coatings at High Temperatures

Due to the fact that MoS₂ and iron oxide layer ceramic coatings have a dry friction coefficient of 10 times higher than that of the substrate, the friction coefficient is long and stable after the initial friction. It is not easy to cause friction flow, and can solve the problem of multiple friction under high load conditions. Such as high-speed bearing lubrication, bearing lubrication under high load, and other friction conditions, using the machine to maintain metal lubrication and cooling of the bearing, the friction and wear resistance of the coating is improved.

rows: Coating layer surface bonding of metallurgical combination

The coating layer material (base layer) and substrate material (base material) are heated to the melting point or near melting point, and the coating material and substrate material undergo mutual diffusion and alloying at high temperature, forming a metallurgical bonded layer. The coating material is a true metallurgical combination of the typical representative.

The welded joint is a metal-to-metal bond. This type of bond is formed by the metallurgical combination of the base metal and the coating metal. It has high bonding strength and good combination quality. The coating material and base material undergo electric arc heating and high-temperature treatment, and the electric arc melts the coating, lowering the melting point. Laser and arc welding are used for high-temperature heating, and the coating is melted and combined with the base metal. Electric arc welding uses the electrode as the heat source in the second half of the electrode work, and the electrode material forms a composite coating layer. The process of arc welding in the coating is strictly controlled, and the difference between the coating surface and the surrounding area is large, but the coating layer is a base metal alloy that is far from the ideal metal alloy combination, and the cooling and solidification of the base metal follows the law. Due to the base metal's own chemical composition, the alloy coating layer and the base metal have a certain degree of brittleness, and the heating method can speed up the cooling speed, etc. At the cooling speed (generally 10°C/s or higher), the coating material's structure will change, and the original structure will be retained. Use laser light to make the metal coating layer speed up the chemical reaction, so the base metal is at the limit of the hardness level, and the shape of the hardened layer structure is not easy to cause brittleness of the metal structure.

At the coating temperature, the coating coating and base material surface undergo mutual diffusion coating, and the base metal forms a diffusion coating. With relative heat dissipation, the coating layer is retained in the diffusion coating layer.

Vacuum coating is a high-temperature gas that will vaporize the coating material, and the coating work surface is melted and dissolved in the coating. Some materials, such as Al/Ni, Ni/Al alloys, are heated to the base metal surface, and the heat is sufficient to cause continuous melting, and a certain thickness of the diffusion coating can be obtained, but the number of layers is a mechanical limitation, so the vacuum coating layer structure is below a certain amount.

sections.text: Laser Surface Treatment

Laser surface treatment uses laser beam to irradiate the surface of ferrous alloys. The laser beam can reach 10^10 V/s of cooling rate. Ferrous alloy surface rapid cooling and rapid heating can refine the grain structure, reduce the segregation of alloying elements, and improve the corrosion resistance of ferrous alloys. Common laser surface treatment methods include: Al, Ca, Cu, Mo, Ni, Si, W, Al+Cu, Al+Mo, Al+Ni, Al+Si, etc., with good corrosion resistance. The laser surface treatment has the following characteristics: 1) Laser surface treatment is heavy. Can obtain fine and uniform microstructure, improve the corrosion resistance of ferrous alloys. 2) Laser surface alloy formation. Can form alloy surface with high hardness and corrosion resistance. 3) Laser quenching (also called laser annealing). The alloy surface is quenched to form a hardened surface layer, improving the corrosion resistance of ferrous alloys. If ferrous alloys are treated with laser surface quenching, the surface hardness Mg-Al composite, the composite layer structure and phase α(Al) and β(Mg, Al), the surface forms a shared layer, and the laser quenching characteristics are located at the transition zone 7-9.0, the hardness increases with time, and the hardness increases with the hardness of Cu₀.₇Zn₀.₃, the coating layer Cu₀.₇Zn₀.₃ Mg/SiC base layer has good corrosion resistance, the material corrosion resistance (Ecorr) compared to the base material increased by 3.7 times
Gas Phase Deposition
Using physical vapor deposition (PVD), chemical vapor deposition (CVD) and other ion implantation (BAD) and other technologies, can obtain a certain corrosion resistance protective layer
Chemical Conversion Coating

Chemical conversion coating uses material selection to have: 1) provides electrical insulation of the substrate; 2) can act as a substrate for organic coating; 3) can form a substrate for organic coating. In addition, phosphate coating can be used for lubrication and corrosion prevention. The distance between the high-temperature zone and the vacuum chamber is 50-500mm. The ion beam is fixed in the vacuum chamber at a predetermined position, forming a flat mirror structure with uniform coating. The advantages are: in the surface coating process, the coating state is improved, the surface roughness is reduced, and the corrosion resistance of the composite coating is improved. The corrosion potential is 200mV, the ion beam is localized to the surface, reducing the surface corrosion rate.

Ferrous alloy surface protection and coating treatment, commonly used methods are: chemical conversion, anodic oxidation, oil coating and metal coating protection. Is the most effective method of coating, coating method can prevent rust effect, can be selected according to specific conditions

sections.text: 3 Balance of Rotating Parts
3.1 Basic Concepts

A rotating part with a certain rotation speed is a rotor. Due to the uneven distribution of material and the difference in the shape of the part (especially the addition of some parts), the installation position is not symmetrical (such as eccentricity) and other reasons, the rotation axis of the part and the main inertial axis do not coincide. When rotating at high speed, the unbalanced centrifugal force will cause the rotor to vibrate, and the vibration will not be balanced. Therefore, the vibration of the rotor is not balanced, and the vibration of the rotor is not balanced.
C = meω² = me(πn/30)² (N)
Formula (1-8-1)

Where: m — mass of rotor, kg; e — eccentricity of rotor mass relative to rotation axis, i.e., distance from center of mass, m; n — rotation speed of rotor, r/min; ω — angular velocity of rotor, rad/s.

From formula (1-8-1), it can be seen that the unbalanced centrifugal force of a high-speed rotor with a small eccentricity can cause a large unbalanced force, which becomes the main cause of shaft fracture, bearing damage, shaft loosening, shaft system, machine vibration and basic vibration. Therefore, machines, especially high-speed and heavy-duty machines, must be equipped with balance.

items: Static imbalance—the rotor's main inertial axis and the rotation axis do not coincide, but are parallel to each other, and the rotor's center of mass is not on the rotation axis. As shown in 1-8-1a. When the rotor rotates, the center of mass moves.

Dynamic imbalance—the rotor's main inertial axis and the rotation axis intersect, and the rotor's center of mass is on the rotation axis. As shown in Figure 1-8-1b. As shown in Figure 1-8-1c. When the rotor rotates, it produces an unbalanced centrifugal force and moment.

The anode oxidation treatment solution composition is divided into two types: acidic oxidation and alkaline oxidation. The main oxidizing salts are chromic acid, sulfuric acid, and phosphoric acid. The anode oxidation treatment of iron-based alloys is mainly based on the following: (1) The oxide film produced by anode oxidation treatment is thin and has low corrosion resistance. It is necessary to use a certain thickness of oxide film to improve corrosion resistance. If the oxide film is too thick, it will cause hydrogen embrittlement and reduce the corrosion resistance of the substrate. (2) The anode oxidation treatment solution contains dissolved salts, which can form a protective oxide layer on the surface of the workpiece. The oxide layer is thin and has low corrosion resistance. Therefore, it is necessary to perform color matching and sealing treatment. The color matching and sealing treatment methods are different from those of aluminum alloy anode oxidation treatment.

sections.text: (3) Rare Earth Element Anode Oxidation Treatment

Also known as rare earth element anode oxidation treatment, it is a method of using electrochemical methods to deposit rare earth elements into the oxide film formed on the surface of the workpiece in an electrochemical environment. In the electrochemical process, rare earth element electrochemistry and electrochemistry are used together to form a protective oxide film. It is suitable for aluminum alloys, magnesium alloys, titanium alloys, niobium alloys, tantalum alloys, and other alloys. The rare earth element anode oxidation treatment is generally divided into 4 stages: the first stage is the formation of the rare earth oxide film; the second stage is the rare earth oxide film sealing, and the formation of rare earth element oxide film; the third stage is the rare earth element further sealing; the fourth stage is the rare earth element oxidation film formation. The rare earth element anode oxidation film has a dense structure, with a dense oxide layer on the surface, a porous oxide layer in the middle, and a dense oxide layer at the bottom. The rare earth element anode oxidation film has small pores, high pore density, good corrosion resistance, and good combination with the substrate. The rare earth element anode oxidation film has high hardness, good wear resistance, and good fatigue resistance. The rare earth element anode oxidation film can be used in aerospace, automobiles, machinery, chemical industry, electronics, medical equipment, and other fields.

sections.text: Chapter 9 Design Elements for Engineering Plastics and Powder Metallurgy Parts
1 Design Elements for Engineering Plastic Parts
1.1 Plastic Classification, Forming Methods and Applications

Plastics can be divided into thermoplastics and thermosetting plastics based on their thermal properties. Thermoplastics have the characteristic that they can be repeatedly softened and hardened. Typical products include polyethylene terephthalate, polyethylene, polypropylene, polystyrene, polyamide, ABS, polyether ether ketone, polyimide, polyetherimide, fluoroplastic, polyvinyl chloride, vinyl plastic, etc.

Thermosetting plastics have the characteristic that they are fixed under certain temperature conditions, and after a certain time of heating, they are cured by chemical cross-linking agents. The cured products have high hardness, good rigidity, and cannot be softened by heating again. Typical products include phenolic plastic, epoxy resin, unsaturated polyester resin, melamine formaldehyde resin, urea formaldehyde resin, etc.

General-purpose plastics can be divided into general-purpose plastics and engineering plastics. General-purpose plastics have the characteristics of easy molding, low cost, wide application range, easy forming and processing, such as PVC, PE, PP, PS, etc. Engineering plastics have the characteristics of high strength, low temperature resistance, good electrical properties, and comprehensive performance, which can replace metal materials in certain engineering structures, such as polyetherimide, ABS, polyether ether ketone, polyimide, heat-resistant polyester, etc.

Functional plastics have the characteristic of having certain special physical properties, such as high temperature resistance, wear resistance, corrosion resistance, electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, self-lubrication, etc., such as fluorine-containing plastics, polyimide, polyetherimide, polyetheretherketone, polyetherimide, polybutylene terephthalate, etc.

sections.text: Chapter 10 Functional Parameters Related to Ergonomics in Human-Machine Engineering
1 Application of Human Body Dimension Percentile Numbers in Product Design

In product design, human body dimension percentile numbers are used. Percentile is a position indicator, a numerical value that satisfies pk representation. A percentile number indicates that the body sample's cumulative observation value is divided into two parts, with K% of the observation value being greater than and less than it, with (100-K)% of the measured value being less than it. Human body dimension percentile numbers are expressed as percentile numbers, indicating a certain human body dimension range within, with a percentile of the human body dimension below it being a value. For example: the 5th percentile is represented as "small" body type, meaning only 5% of the measured value is below the lower limit. The 95th percentile is represented as "large" body type, meaning only 5% of the measured value is above the upper limit. The 50th percentile is represented as "medium" body type, meaning 50% of the measured value is higher and lower than the measured value.

Product dimension design should exclude the human body dimension percentile number calculation, strictly follow the following principles, and be suitable for correction. To achieve the actual function of a certain functional surface as a product dimension design basis, the human body dimension percentile number is used as the functional correction measure. To ensure the implementation of a certain functional surface as a product dimension design basis, the human body dimension percentile number is used as the functional correction measure. To ensure the implementation of a product's certain functional surface setting of the product's minimum functional dimension (= human body dimension percentile number + functional correction), so the design of the product's dimension is at least used, to meet the ground use of a percentage of the population, called satisfaction degree.
1.1 Selection of Human Body Dimension Percentile Numbers (from GB/T 12985—1991)
(1) Classification of Product Dimension Design

items: Type I product dimension design: requires two human body dimension percentile numbers as the upper and lower limit values, called Type I product dimension design. Also called dual limit value design.

Type II product dimension design: requires only one human body dimension percentile number as the upper limit value or lower limit value, called Type II product dimension design. Also called single limit value design.
Type IIA product dimension design: requires only one human body dimension percentile number as the lower limit value, called Type IIA product dimension design. Also called dimension design.
Type IIB product dimension design: requires only one human body dimension percentile number as the lower limit value, called Type IIB product dimension design. Also called small dimension design.
Type III product dimension design: requires 50 percentile (P50) as the product dimension design basis, called Type III product dimension design. Also called median dimension design.

sections.text: (2) Selection of Percentile Numbers

items: For Type I product dimension design, for products related to human health and safety, use P5 and P95 as the upper and lower limit values. This should be satisfied as 98%; for general industrial products, use P5 and P5 as the upper and lower limit values. This should be satisfied as 90%.

For Type IIA product dimension design, for products related to human health and safety, use P5, P5, P95 as the upper and lower limit values. This should be satisfied as 99% or 95%; for general industrial products, use P50 as the upper and lower limit values. This should be satisfied as 90%.

sections.text: 2 Powder Metallurgy Component Design Elements
2.1 Characteristics and Main Applications of Powder Metallurgy

Powder metallurgy is a metal powder (or metal alloy powder or non-ferrous metal powder composite) processing method. Through forming and sintering, various types of metal components with different shapes are produced. It has many advantages: (1) Using powder metallurgy methods can produce components with special properties and materials, such as controlling the density of the component, making the pore size and distribution uniform, and achieving metal and non-metal composite materials, metal and ceramic composite materials, etc. (2) Forming is cutting-free or near-cutting, which can reduce machine tool wear and improve production efficiency. The surface roughness can reach public class 12-13 levels, and sometimes up to 10 levels. The surface finish is high, with numerical values below 1.6 μm. However, powder metallurgy components have limitations, and the size and shape must be controlled within certain limits. Powder metallurgy materials are mainly used in the manufacture of mechanical parts, tool materials, magnetic materials, electrical materials, high-temperature materials and refractory materials, etc. For powder metallurgy components, the composition, properties, and characteristic applications should be referred to in the material manual.

sections.text: Chapter 1

sections.caption: Design considerations and improved design examples for magnesium alloy castings and dissimilar metal connections
rows: Magnesium alloy castings and dissimilar metal connections: Magnesium alloy structural parts are composed of non-ferrous metals and alloys such as aluminum and magnesium. Magnesium alloy parts have poor corrosion resistance compared to ferrous materials. The structural parts are prone to electrochemical corrosion. Therefore, to prevent electrochemical corrosion between magnesium alloy structural parts and dissimilar metal connection parts, the material selection and surface treatment methods should be used to prevent corrosion as shown in the figure.
Figure (b) Connection between magnesium alloy and dissimilar metal parts

Magnesium alloy and aluminum alloy assembly: The electrochemical potential difference between magnesium and aluminum alloys is the main cause of galvanic corrosion. To prevent galvanic corrosion between magnesium and aluminum alloys, the following methods can be used: (1) Select different metal combinations with small electrochemical potential differences; (2) Use insulating materials to isolate the two metals; (3) Use protective coatings.

Magnesium alloy and other metal assembly: When magnesium alloy is in contact with other metals, galvanic corrosion may occur. To prevent this, the following measures should be taken: (1) Select appropriate metal combinations; (2) Use insulating materials to separate the metals; (3) Apply protective coatings. For magnesium alloys 5052, 6053, 6061, 6063 and their alloys, when used with copper alloys, brass (80% Sn-20% Zn) alloys, and other metals, special attention must be paid to corrosion prevention. For magnesium alloys and other metal assemblies, the assembly method must be selected to prevent galvanic corrosion.
Figure (c) Various connection methods for magnesium alloy and dissimilar metal parts

Isolation of dissimilar metals: To prevent galvanic corrosion between dissimilar metals, an insulating layer should be used to separate them. When using an insulating layer with a thickness of 0.08 mm or more, or using an insulating coating or adhesive, the galvanic corrosion can be effectively prevented.
Figure (d) Sealed connection structure for magnesium alloy parts

Surface treatment: To ensure good corrosion resistance of magnesium alloy parts, surface treatment is essential. The surface should be free of corrosion products and moisture. To prevent crevice corrosion, the design should avoid crevices and water accumulation. In addition, the parts should be designed to avoid sharp corners and stress concentration. Figures e and f show the design considerations for magnesium alloy parts to prevent galvanic corrosion.

sections.text: Selection of Fasteners for Welded Joints

Titanium alloys should not be used as fasteners, and large-scale welded assemblies should be avoided. Fasteners should be selected based on the working environment. In general, for titanium alloy materials that can be used in welded assemblies, stainless steel fasteners should be used. If the fastener material can meet the chemical corrosion resistance requirements, it can be used in titanium alloy welded assemblies. For steel fasteners, generally use 5052 alloy rivets. For steel fasteners, copper rivets, steel rivets, copper rivets, tin rivets (except 5056, 6053 or 6061 aluminum alloys) or brass rivets and screws. In titanium alloy assemblies, due to the incompatibility of materials, brass rivets should not be used, and chemical treatment should be performed after assembly.
For special fasteners with threaded holes, special mechanical layers can be used, such as zinc-plated material spray, epoxy resin and high-temperature resistant coating layers.

1.1 Using differential screw spiral surface friction to achieve a hand wheel complete automatic and fine adjustment

Figure 1-13-1 shows a differential screw mechanism with spiral surface friction drive. The drive work is 1 movement, screw 2 after time delay, by the cam (not shown in the figure) pushes the work table to move, so that the work table with screw 1 rotates, screw 2 rotates hand wheel 8, the spiral groove on the screw surface has a pitch of M8×0.8 spiral groove friction drive force at 0.7mm, fine adjustment time, hand wheel 7, 5, 6, 7 three small teeth friction force is relatively connected as one, so screw 2 does not rotate. This is because the design point is that the spiral groove on screw 2 is at the end of the friction 0 angle of inclination, so the circular groove separation of the friction force is less than M8×0.7 of the spiral groove friction force. Due to the rotation of hand wheel 7, screw 2 and screw support seat 4 will not rotate, because M18×0.8 and M8×0.7 of the next spiral groove (same direction) form a differential screw. Fine adjustment hand wheel rotation one week, work table movement 0.1mm.

1.3 Century Monument Transmission Scheme Design

The Century Monument is located at the north edge of Beijing's 21st Century Building Project. Based on the concept of "Heaven moves, and the son of heaven follows"; the earth is thick and carries things" in the I Ching, it is designed to represent the spiritual heritage of the Chinese nation. The requirement is to reach 3000t, with a diameter of 47m representing the "sky". The monument rotates 4-6 hours per week. For this project, three transmission schemes are proposed.
(1) Water Bearing Scheme (Figure 1-13-3)

sections.caption: Figure 1-13-3 Floating Bearing Scheme
sections.description: Technical drawing showing a cross-sectional view of a floating bearing transmission system. The diagram displays: diameter φ17m at the top, dimensions of 48.66m and φ15m marked horizontally, vertical height of 1.5m, auxiliary support and drive mechanism on the left side, ground level (地平面) and soil surface (土台平面) marked on the right. The base shows diameter φ35m and φ36m measurements, with water tank depth of 2.5m, water tank width of 0.8m, and various internal structural components including vertical support columns.

sections.text: This scheme has a rotating monument base with a fixed diameter of 35m, placed in a circular water tank with diameter 36m. The water tank bottom is 0.8m above the ground. The water depth is 2.5m. The water bearing supports 95% of the monument's weight, with 5% supported by side bearings. Due to water's resistance to friction, the friction resistance is much smaller than the monument's weight, so the friction resistance can be almost eliminated. The design considerations include: water occupies a certain height (limited by the height of the Century Monument base), water freezes in winter and cracks in summer (requiring preventive measures), and earthquakes and other geological conditions may cause damage, such as water leakage and flooding.
(2) Friction Drive Scheme (Figure 1-13-4)

The plastic wheels are arranged in a circular pattern around the base structure.

sections.text: This scheme uses a rotating monument base with 296 plastic wheels of 1m diameter each, supported on a circular track below. A friction wheel is used to drive the circular track. The advantages of this scheme are: plastic wheels are wear-resistant, the circular track and friction wheel transmission are simple and reliable, and the two functions of load-bearing and transmission are separated, conforming to the design principle of "division of labor". The key points are that plastic wheels must be able to withstand long-term aging, the support surface must be large enough to ensure sufficient friction, the plastic wheels must have sufficient hardness, and the center of gravity of the circular track must be stable and return to center.

1.2 Multi-head Screw Semi-automatic Lathe

Multi-head screw semi-automatic lathes use additional light-guiding instruments to guide the head screw, and this type of screw is commonly used with numbers 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, etc., for different matching accuracy requirements, and sometimes rotation adaptation is needed.

As shown in Figure 1-13-2, the semi-automatic lathe transmission system can be equipped with 1.5mm screws numbered 2, 4, 6, 8 for the target screw. Only the operator needs to operate the screw, and the screw can be fully automatically advanced.
(1) Transmission System

The main feature is the use of a round table with 2 belt-driven large flat plates for reciprocating motion. The main shaft of the lathe and the spindle rotate together with a certain transmission ratio to achieve the purpose of controlling the multi-head screw feed. 1.6 Magnetic Levitation Train

The magnetic levitation train relies on electromagnetic force to suspend the train in the air and guide it along the track without mechanical contact with the track surface, achieving contactless operation. Due to the elimination of wheel and rail friction limitations, the magnetic levitation train overcomes the problems of traditional train wheel wear and noise.
The magnetic levitation train is mainly composed of a levitation system, guidance system, and propulsion system, which together form a complete guidance system with three major subsystems.
(1) Levitation System

The current levitation system design can be classified into two types. The electromagnetic levitation system (EMS) is the conventional type, also called the attractive magnetic levitation type, which uses fixed high-speed magnetic levitation trains as representatives, as shown in Figure 1-13-16a.

sections.text: Figure 1-13-24 shows the original diagram of a thin film type magnetic flux compression micropump. The micropump uses a circular diaphragm structure. When the magnetic field changes, the diaphragm undergoes elastic deformation. When the magnetic field increases, the diaphragm deflects upward, and the inlet opens, allowing fluid to flow in. When the magnetic field decreases, the diaphragm deflects downward, the inlet closes, and the outlet opens, allowing fluid to be expelled. The fluid flow can be controlled by changing the external magnetic field frequency. The advantages of the thin film type magnetic flux compression micropump are: it can adopt a contactless drive method, which makes the structural design simple. Additionally, the superconducting magnetic flux compression drive can achieve long-distance operation, making it suitable for use in microfluidic control devices such as liquid valves and gas fast-switching solenoid valves.

The input and output shafts are connected by a belt drive as an external characteristic.
(2) Principle

This reducer is a 22×X star planetary gear transmission structure. The driving force is input to the sun gear 20, driving the planetary gear 9 on the planetary frame 21 to rotate; the planetary gear and fixed internal gear 2 mesh. When the frame rotates, the centerline of the planetary gear rotates around the sun gear main axis, causing the planetary frame to output the reduction speed rotation. The reduction ratio is 4-13.
(3) Characteristics
The reducer structure has the following characteristics:

items: The input shaft is hollow and can be used with a disk to achieve the input shaft without keyway connection, and the installation direction is flexible.
The sun gear and input shaft use split design, with good process performance.

The input shaft uses a non-force-bearing design, and the internal gear on both sides of the planetary gear is adjusted to ensure the planetary shaft position is controlled and the shaft is not deflected.

The planetary gear bearing is internal, with small outer diameter and direct use of the bearing column, in the direction of less than 1 hour, can reduce the radial dimension of the reducer, providing conditions for the radial dimension design.
The planetary frame and input shaft are integrated as one, with simple structure and good rigidity.
The input shaft 9 passes through a set of sleeves fixed on the upper bearing seat 12 and the lower shaft-bearing sleeve 7 and is fixed on the lower sleeve 6, with simple and compact structure.

Due to the simplification of the input and output shaft bearing structure, the overall structure of the reducer is compact. However, at the same time, it also increases the difficulty of manufacturing, because the relevant parts cannot be added with surface treatment and hardening process.

The magnetic suspension train's driving system uses a linear motor principle. sections.text: Compared with piezoelectric (PZT) and ferromagnetic magnetic shape memory materials such as Ni and Co, ultramagnetic shape memory materials have unique properties: at room temperature, the variable strain is large (1500-2000ppm), which is 40-50 times that of piezoelectric ceramics, 5-8 times that of pressure-type ceramics, and can achieve high frequency (14000-250001/m), which is 400-500 times that of piezoelectric ceramics, 10-14 times that of mechanical systems; the response speed is fast (reaching μs level); the output force can reach 220-880N. The following describes the application of ultramagnetic shape memory materials in several types of actuators.
(1) Direct drive type ultramagnetic shape memory actuator (Figure 1-13-18)

The main design uses a rod-shaped magnetic shape memory composite as a direct drive actuator, without using a large machine. Due to the fact that the joint pressure is much greater than the joint pull force, a pre-stressed spring is used to maintain a certain magnetic field, so that the magnetic shape memory rod is always in a state of combined stress. This type of magnetic shape memory actuator has a simple structure, fast response, and is mainly used in water displacement devices, new type horses, and micro-displacement control valves in oil flow.

(6) Fluid Vibration Damper

sections.text: 1.5 Stirring equipment using eccentric screw effect for stirring

Stirring equipment is commonly used in chemical industry. Due to material properties not being well matched with the design and installation configuration, the return of the eccentric and rotational center does not coincide. Under rotational drive, unbalanced eccentric forces are generated, affecting the deformation of the equipment. When the degree is large, the shaft cannot maintain level operation. In stirring equipment with relatively low speed, the shaft center must be firmly fixed at the bottom, and if using eccentric screw effect, the shaft bottom can be equipped with a fixed bearing, which can hold the shaft in the middle and bottom bearing of the shaft (Figure 1-13-14). When performing secondary finishing (fine finishing), the finishing allowance will affect the opening diameter and the internal stress of the combined hole. Therefore, the finishing allowance should be determined according to the closing direction of the problem. The reduction amount Δ is calculated by the following formula. If the amount of finishing is too large, the opening angle after closing will be small, and the opening diameter after finishing will have a part of the work that cannot be recovered. It is impossible to ensure the sealing degree. The gas tightness, relative diameter and relative diameter force distribution and other working conditions cannot be guaranteed. Therefore, a large amount of waste is generated. The following public formula is derived through practical work and theoretical exploration:
Coarse finishing outer diameter = pressure reduction outer diameter - (2Δ/3π + Δ/6) + z
Coarse finishing inner diameter = pressure reduction inner diameter - 2Δ/3π - z

In the formula: Δ—difference between the opening diameter and the pressure reduction opening diameter; z—two-sided finishing allowance (safety margin), taking 350~500mm left and right diameter active ring clearance 2.5~3mm. Vertical opening direction deformation (i.e., axial deformation) y = 2Δ/3π; Parallel opening direction deformation (i.e., radial deformation) x = 2Δ/3π + Δ/6. It should be noted that when opening and closing, the opening force on both sides of the opening should be similar (the force should be close to the opening on both sides), or use a steel belt to collect together.

Since the introduction of foreign advanced gear reducer technology documents into the country, one of the major equipment machinery paper technology documents has been carried out in production. It is necessary to focus on the main several installation dimensions and not to change the work, using domestic materials to reach the advanced product level and other performance indicators. The traditional involute gear transmission design has no practical requirements. The new involute gear is only the main gear tooth profile does not change, in the degree of the main work direction and the direction of the combined position, the variable system number Z and X, by the degree, the variable front shaft angle Z does not change the gear tooth profile. Non-essential variable gear shape is determined by the change of the body, that is, the pitch does not change, the pitch position, the variable after the pitch changes. The direction of the position is in the direction of the variable position of the base, the direction of the position number Z and X₀ is set, but generally is -0.2 ~ +0.3. Large gear tooth cutting variable system number is not constrained, forming two independent design features, that is, both have functions, such as balance curve, slow and fast speed shaft "simulation" phenomenon. The new involute non-essential variable gear tooth design has the following advantages: ① high bearing capacity; ② extended service life; ③ low noise; ④ small volume; ⑤ in the existing machine tool operation, such as production machine, precision machine, excellent machine and other machines. In the same control precision, materials, and number of teeth conditions, the new non-essential variable gear tooth shows the world's various gear tooth transmission strength average of 1 time, the strength is 1.3 (positive action). Using new gear shape design to complete the national production, and after years of testing, trial and test and factory comparison test and equipment record, proving the production success. sections.text: 1.20 Modern Automatic Transmission System

Figure 1-13-69 shows a schematic diagram of a modern automatic transmission system. It is mainly composed of an engine, fluid converter, gear converter, oil pump, control system and other components. The control system has both hydraulic and electronic control methods. The electronic control system monitors the oil pressure and fluid pressure, uses electronic sensors to detect various parameters of automatic transmission and engine operation, such as air intake position, speed, engine speed, water temperature, oil pressure, oil temperature, throttle, and even vehicle speed and other information, performs real-time detection and inspection, and based on the inspection results and related control procedures, performs comprehensive processing. Then the control decision is made according to the preset control logic for each control, achieving the engine's output shaft and transmission input shaft speed ratio intelligent control, reaching the vehicle's optimal operating efficiency. The machine can only achieve the preset control logic for "reserve", "parking", "low speed", "forward" and other driving positions.

1.19 Rational Layout of Machine Tool
(1) Comparison of Parallel-Kinematic Machine Tool and Traditional Machine Tool

Parallel-kinematic machine tools are spatial parallel mechanisms, which can use the computing power of numerical control to control the movement of each part of the mechanism, so that the electrical equipment and electronic equipment can take the Cartesian coordinate system as the reference frame to move, so that the system structure and operation principle of the machine tool remain unchanged.

sections.description: The figure shows two machine tool configurations side by side. On the left is a traditional machine tool (传统机床) with labeled components including: column (立柱), spindle (主轴部件), tool point (刀头点), work table (工作台), and main component (主轴部件). On the right is a parallel-kinematic machine tool (并联运动机床) with labeled components including: machine bed frame (机床框架), spindle rod (伸缩杆), tool point (刀头点), work table (工作台), and dynamic platform (动平台).

sections.text: The basic layout of parallel-kinematic machine tools is: the machine bed frame is used as the fixed platform, the upper part of the machine bed frame is composed of a spatial parallel mechanism, the main component is installed on the parallel mechanism of the moving platform, which changes the position of the work piece, so that the main component can achieve X, Y, Z axis movement and rotation around the axis. According to the parallel-kinematic machine tool principle, the position of the tool point is determined by the position of the main component on the work table.

For traditional machine tools, the basic feature is that it is a cantilever structure, the main component is installed on the work table's sliding plate support, which is driven by the X, Y, Z axis drive to move, forming the position of the tool point on the work table. Due to the parallel-kinematic machine tool structure and the cantilever structure of the traditional machine tool, the spindle motor and machine are integrated into one unit, so there are many advantages in rigidity, dynamics, and machine tool accuracy, and it is easy to weight with machine structure, which is a new direction for the development of machine tool structure.
(2) Rational Layout Example of Parallel-Kinematic Machine Tool

Hexact type machine tool design layout is reasonable, simple structure, novel, in a hexagonal shape of the platform structure on the side, with the frame structure surface at 30° angle to 6 spindle rods, the spindle rod's other end through a directional lock to support fixed on the frame corner. The spindle rod's other end passes through a directional lock to support fixed on the main component's fixed body, and its corner point is at the parallel-kinematic machine tool's lower platform (hexagonal frame surface and spindle component surface), which can be placed on the horizontal plane, so the structural position of all components is reasonable.

sections.text: (1) Design Description
The test gasoline engine and dynamometer are connected using rubber bushing couplings. The engine output shaft is not flying, directly connected to the input shaft.
(2) Operating Conditions
The gasoline engine operates under load at rated speed, not exceeding 30 min. The rubber bushing coupling shows complete fracture, with the rubber interior showing a layered structure.
(3) Failure Cause

Due to the lack of flying support, the unbalanced load on the output shaft during rotation is not evenly distributed to the rubber bushing coupling, causing severe alternating stress and leading to rubber fatigue fracture and hardening.
(4) Design and Process Improvements

Replace the rubber bushing coupling with a chain coupling. The chain teeth are spaced at intervals of less than 2 mm to ensure tooth hardness and wear resistance. The hardness value is 45HRC or higher. Additionally, the coupling is connected to the shaft using a key form to reduce the load on the chain and improve performance to meet requirements.

Oxygen-containing silica (Si₃N₄) is statically used as a seal ring installed on the shaft. The seal ring is filled with inert gas to isolate the pure inert gas seal surface from the seal surface. The static pressure is applied to the shaft seal through the shaft seal on the upper wheel, so that the seal surface is in contact. The two seals in the liquid have good corrosion resistance, but their friction characteristics are poor, and the friction coefficient is high, which is not conducive to hard material situations. 2.15 Gear Reducer High-Speed Shaft No-Load Operation
(1) Design Overview

Certain gear transmission high-speed shaft operates at 1000r/min or above or in a low-temperature environment. The high-speed shaft has bearing clearance and axial force effects. If the gear reducer high-speed shaft is to operate at a fixed position without load, the bearing support structure must be designed according to Figure 1-13-92a, which is a commonly used structure for fixing the shaft in the inner circle.
(2) Cause of Failure

As shown in Figure a, when the pressure bearing is installed with the outer race circle, the gear reducer enters the high-speed rotation, causing the shaft bearing to rise abnormally, and the axial force suddenly increases. The main cause is that during the gear reducer operation, the high-speed shaft rises after load, causing the bearing raceway to increase the force.
(3) Improvement Measures and Effects

The improvement method is to position the shaft inner circle outside the fixed circle position, at the end using the spiral bearing to support the outer race circle pressure, as shown in Figure b. When the high-speed shaft is heated and elongated, the shaft inner circle position can move freely, the shaft has no additional load, ensuring high-speed shaft operation stability.

sections.text: 2.16 Diesel Engine Unit Vibration Isolation System Self-Excited Vibration
(1) Design Overview
The design requires that the diesel engine unit vibration isolation system can work normally and be able to isolate vibration.
(2) Cause of Failure

As shown in Figure a, due to the self-excited isolation effect, although the isolation effect is good, the elastic spring is too soft, causing the unit to not work normally. Due to the spring being too soft, the vibration isolation frequency is close to the diesel engine frequency. When the diesel engine starts, the vibration amplitude increases rapidly. The fixed frequency is close to the diesel engine frequency, and as the engine speed increases, the vibration amplitude increases, causing the diesel engine to be unable to work normally.
(3) Improvement Measures and Effects

Under the condition of meeting the vibration isolation requirements, reduce the first-order vibration isolation frequency, reduce the second-order vibration isolation frequency step, as shown in the figure, increase the first and second-order vibration isolation frequency step, so that the vibration isolation frequency is far away from the engine frequency, suppressing self-excited vibration with natural frequency. It is also effective to increase the system damping, but it is more restrictive.

sections.text: 2.13 Forest Biomass Crusher Innovative Design

Currently, our country's biomass crusher mainly uses powder operation of plant stalks to produce animal feed. Its use of the crusher is mainly based on the standard design of hammer mill crushers. Its hammer-type crusher structure is simple, durable, suitable for high-strength advantages, and the largest output. Hammer-type crusher structure diagram shown in Figure 1-13-86 shows that during work, materials are fed into the crushing chamber, first the hammer strikes the material, and at the same time the grinding degree is applied to the fixed grinding in the crushing chamber. The material is retained on the sieve and sieve mesh, receiving the grinding of the sieve and the friction of the sieve mesh for further grinding. In the crushing chamber, if the heavy material is repeated, the direct powder reaches the discharge hole to stop.

items.text: Existing problems: The crusher sieve size is too large (more than 10mm or more), cannot meet the requirements of later use, will not add the work to add the finished rice-level aggregate.

Improvement of crusher design: (1) The biomass crusher sieve chamber is too round, the rotor belt drive is too high speed, the grain cutting speed is very fast, from the use of grain sieve hole time is short, affecting the grain separation efficiency. Solution: a. Install a baffle on the crusher chamber, as shown in Figure 1-13-87, the baffle flow device is a circular baffle surface, using adhesive material control. The baffle makes the material stay in the baffle surface longer, moving at the same time to avoid external work on the surface, reducing the short residence time of the material, from the baffle circulation flow, at the same time strengthening the material cutting and operation use, improving the grain separation efficiency. b. On the sieve mesh of the mill, the baffle is set to move the rotor structure, the baffle passes through the rotor structure and the rotor is related. When the grain is in the grain material, the hammer strikes the material, the material will force to reach the sieve and pass through the sieve mesh, improving the separation ability.

(2) After crushing, the grain size becomes 1mm or less, light weight, small center of gravity, from the grain size is small, not easy to pass through the sieve hole. Solution: Use a vibrating sieve, suction device, increase the material separation force, improve the equipment production capacity.

(3) Design requirements: For a biomass crusher, the machine can be kept at various tree species containing height, thickness, diameter of small wood, branches and other plant materials into rice-level aggregate. Solution method: As shown in Figure 1-13-88, use a multi-level sieve, a primary sieve is separated by a sieve plate and a grain sieve plate composition, mainly for material into a group grain sieve; secondary sieve uses a sieve plate structure, for the grain sieve material into a step grain sieve, to achieve the required grain size. And use a vibrating sieve, through the experimental determination of the separation force and the original material water content rate relationship, find the separation of the smallest maximum water content rate.

Everyone knows that several types of shaft symbols are mainly to measure the relative displacement of the shaft to meet the requirements of long-distance transmission. In practice, the following conditions must be met:

items: The pipe routing at the shaft location must meet the requirements of the shaft combination design. The pipe line cannot have "dead legs". This means that the pipe should be able to move smoothly, and the speed of change of the transported material should be able to meet the requirements below. For simple lines, the general requirement is that the installation is sufficient, not too detailed.

2.21 Improved Design of J28 Type 3.3m Coal Gas Furnace
Coal gas furnace is a main equipment for synthesizing ammonia production raw materials.
(1) Operational Process and Improvement Requirements

items: Coal to carbon ratio should be separated. Requires high operating process wind speed, high furnace layer, high furnace temperature and low two-carbon compound content. High furnace layer refers to maintaining carbon layer height at 1500-2000mm, which is beneficial for CO₂ original reaction, which is beneficial to controlling the amount of multi-quality gas. High furnace temperature refers to maintaining carbon layer temperature at 1200-1300°C, which can improve the efficiency of carbon strengthening.
The furnace should be able to timely discharge ash without blocking, without wall sticking phenomenon, without blocking the furnace bottom ash discharge.
Coal gas is ash-free. Related to the above requirements, need to be improved below.

sections.text: Improvements needed based on the above requirements:

items: Furnace discharge structure improvement.
Furnace bottom component improvement for furnace discharge.
Should install heating machine, and design, control time to ensure furnace bottom density control.

sections.text: (2) Design Improvements
a. Expand the furnace discharge opening and fix the water jacket height.

b. Furnace bottom component improvement: furnace bottom components include furnace bottom, ash, large gear ring and lower guide ring, etc., see Figure 1-13-99. ① Change the furnace discharge transmission to V-shaped sliding shaft, with rotating fixed point, gear and shaft bearing provided, shaft frame through the bearing, with single bearing hole design. The improved sliding shaft, with the same shaft hole, has the effect of reducing the shaft hole movement, effective stress reduction and shaft hole bearing extension. But the sliding bearing shaft work environment is harsh, the friction bearing shaft work environment is better, the original structure is sealed with a sealed ring, due to the selection of sealed ring orientation is too large, in the lower time the belt brings powder into the sealed ring gap, the powder flows through the sealed ring into the furnace bottom gap, the powder accumulates at the lower guide ring and furnace bottom gap, causing the lower guide ring and furnace bottom to be sealed. Therefore, on the original sealed ring foundation, in the furnace bottom gap, the two lower guide points are positioned at the sealed ring, see Figure 1-13-99 (parts 3 and 10), and the sliding bearing shaft upper guide ring also has a sealed ring (parts 4 and 7). ② Large gear bearing, coal gas furnace ash inside the furnace bottom ash discharge edge (i.e., the discharge opening position) should be a stepped shape, can be lifted to determine the fuel material, so that the balance is below, prevent ash accumulation and coal slag sliding. The discharge area is designed with 3500mm. Furnace bottom external design is 3500mm, furnace bottom relative expansion is large, forming 100mm. The discharge area. ③ Ash hopper design calculation ash funnel angle (minimum 13°), ash discharge length (maximum 800mm), no effective ash discharge design, will ash discharge and timely discharge area; that is, use inlet ash discharge, due to the ash discharge mouth area is too small, the ash discharge is not smooth. But due to the inlet into the furnace bottom gap, the furnace bottom gap is too large, the fire layer position moves, the production capacity decreases, please increase the furnace inlet, the furnace inlet increases the coal gas separation is not uniform, so the ash amount is large, the fire layer position moves, to ensure coal gas furnace production capacity, can not exceed 5 lower layer, otherwise the coal layer will be heated by the furnace wall phenomenon. Want to hit the furnace into the impact coal furnace coal furnace cycle fixed production of important factors.
Improve the furnace bottom structure, re-install the action, see Figure 1-13-100, the key points are: 2-5 layers use thermal insulation, corrosion-resistant grid.

Chapter 1 Mechanical Drawing

The national standard GB/T 14689-2008 stipulates that the technical drawing standards for technical drawings are applicable to technical content, and are applicable to various industries (such as machinery, shipbuilding, construction, soil and gas, etc.). The drawing standards have uniformity, applicability and rigor, and are positioned at a higher level. For industry drawing standards (such as machinery), if there are inconsistencies with the technical drawing standards in GB/T 14689, the technical drawing standards should be followed. If necessary, certain contents of the technical drawing standards should be incorporated into the mechanical drawing standards to supplement the mechanical drawing standards.

5 Font and Its Specifications in CAD Drawings (GB/T 14691—1993, GB/T 14665—2012)

(1) Basic requirements for fonts
1) The characters written in drawings must be neat; fonts should be upright, with clear strokes, uniform spacing, and neat arrangement.
2) Font height h and its common size series are: 1.8 mm, 2.5 mm, 3.5 mm, 5 mm, 7 mm, 10 mm, 14 mm, 20 mm. If characters larger than the above are needed, their height should be determined by multiplying the above series by the magnification factor. Chinese character height is not less than 3.5 mm, and character width is generally h/√2.
3) Italic fonts should be used for construction lines, and the national standard distribution angle should be adopted. Chinese character height should not be less than 3.5 mm, and character width is generally h/√2.
4) Uppercase and lowercase letters are inclined and upright. The top right corner of italic letters is inclined to the right, with an angle of 75° to the horizontal baseline. Application occasions for italic letters:
① Characters in drawings such as dimension letters, view names, public numbers, standard symbols, various structural element symbols, dimension and angle symbols, physical quantity symbols, etc.
② Main content in technical documents.
③ Physical quantity symbols used as subscripts below, such as pressure ratio symbol cₚ, etc. Application occasions for upright letters:
① Measurement unit symbols, such as A (ampere), N (newton), m (meter), etc.
② Unit prefixes, such as k (10³, kilo), m (10⁻³, milli), M (10⁶, mega).
③ Chemical element symbols, such as C (carbon), N (nitrogen), Fe (iron), H₂SO₄ (sulfuric acid), etc.
④ Product symbols, such as JHS-1, etc.
⑤ Graphic partition symbols.
⑥ Physical quantity symbols with subscripts other than the above, such as coefficient of friction μₛ, standard gravitational acceleration gₙ, etc.
⑦ Mathematical symbols sin, cos, lim, ln, etc.
5) The pen stroke width (d) of A-type letters is 1/14 of the font height (h); the pen stroke width (d) of B-type letters is 1/10 of the font height (h).
6) When using fractions, decimals, radical signs, and special symbols, the numbers and letters should generally use smaller fonts.
7) For Chinese characters, find the parent character, phonetic character, radical character, and combine the character and number according to the spacing and distance specifications shown in Figures 2-1-10 and 2-1-3.

sections.text: 8 Drawing Methods for Views
8.1 Orthographic Views (Excerpted from GB/T 17451—1998, GB/T 4458.1—2002)

sections.caption: Table 2-1-12
rows: The basic orthographic view is a view obtained by projecting the object onto the basic projection plane. The arrangement of the six basic views is shown in Figure 1. Generally, the main view is selected as the primary view. If a piece of paper is placed on the drawing board and arranged, standard view names can be marked. The drawing method is shown in the first-angle method and third-angle method. According to GB/T 14692, the first-angle method is preferred. This document adopts the third-angle method. When the object is placed in the third-angle position, the three-view drawing method will project the object onto the projection plane of the observer to obtain the surface projection (the projection direction is opposite), and the sample is distinguished by the symbol shown in Chapter 2.

The directional view is a view drawn from the direction indicated on the orthographic view. The upper left mark on the orthographic view is marked with '×' ('×' is the large letter T-shaped mark), and the relative position of the directional view should be indicated by the arrow direction. The projection direction of the directional view is the same as the arrow direction. For example, as shown in Figure 2, it can also be drawn on the drawing below (or to the right) to mark the view name, such as plan view, elevation view, sectional view, etc.

The local view is a view that projects a certain part of the object onto the basic projection plane indicated by the local view. The local view can be placed based on the position indicated in Figure 3 of the orthographic view, or it can be placed according to the position indicated in Figure 4. The drawing of the local view, with its outline drawn with a thick solid line and a thin solid line, is shown in Figure 3 in Figure 4 of the directional view. When the outline of the part is composed of a closed curve, it should not be interrupted by the boundary line. As shown in Figure 4 of the directional view.

sections.text: 8.2 Sectional Views and Cross-sectional Views (Excerpted from GB/T 17452—1998, GB/T 4458.6—2002)

A sectional view is a hypothetical view obtained by cutting an object with a cutting plane, removing the part between the observer and the cutting plane, and projecting the remaining part onto the projection plane. The cutting plane is called the cutting plane. A cross-sectional view is a hypothetical view obtained by cutting an object with a cutting plane at a specified location, with only the cross-section of the object at the cutting plane shown. The cross-sectional view shows the shape of the cross-section and the contact part between the cutting plane and the object.

sections.caption: Table 2-1-13 Sectional Views and Cross-sectional Views (GB/T 17452—1998)
headers: Classification of Sectional and Cross-sectional Views
rows: According to the structural characteristics of the object, select a single cutting plane (horizontal or vertical) (Figure 1, Figure 2), or multiple intersecting cutting planes (horizontal or vertical) (Figure 3) or multiple parallel cutting planes (horizontal or vertical) (Figure 4)
Full Sectional View: Use a single cutting plane to completely cut through the object to obtain the sectional view (Figure 5)

Full Sectional View: When the object has a symmetrical plane, the view can be drawn with the center line as the axis, with one half as the sectional view (Figure 6) and the other half as the regular view (Figure 6)
Partial Sectional View: Use the cutting plane to cut the part of the object where the cutting plane is located to obtain the sectional view (Figure 7)

Offset Sectional View: The offset sectional view is shown in Figure 2 outside the figure. The cutting plane is bent along the axis line and the line segments, and is positioned on the extended line of the cutting plane or at other specified positions (Figure 8)

Rotated Sectional View: The rotated sectional view is shown in the figure. The cutting plane is rotated around the axis line in the plane of the sectional view. The rotated sectional view is drawn in the same plane as the main view, and the axis line is shown as a continuous thin line (Figure 9)

sections.text: The same assembly drawing can use one method for the arrangement of part sequence numbers. The same drawing should use the same arrangement method. If the same part number appears multiple times in the drawing, it must be indicated by the same sequence number. When the sequence number cannot be placed directly on the drawing due to space limitations, a leader line with an arrow should be used to point to the part. The sequence number should be placed near the end of the leader line. When using this method, the sequence number should be placed in order.

The assembly drawing should use the part sequence numbers, part names, and quantities specified in the parts list. The assembly drawing should follow GB/T 4457.2—2003 (Basic rules for technical drawings). The parts list should follow GB/T 14691—1993 (Technical drawing - Parts list requirements).

sections.text: Dimension Line and Reference Line

Dimension line and reference line: The dimension line should be drawn using actual objects to draw, and the reference line can be drawn in two forms, namely the first and second types. The reference line should be drawn at a distance from the outline, and the dimension line should be drawn parallel to the dimension line. When the dimension line is too short, the dimension line should be extended outside the outline. The dimension line cannot replace the outline line. Generally, it should not be placed on the outline line. The dimension line should be drawn using a thin line. For the dimension line of the curved surface, use an oblique line to draw, and the dimension line and dimension line should be perpendicular to each other (Figure 9).

sections.text: 11.2 Standards for Coordinated Dimensions (GB/T 1801—2009)

For public dimensions greater than 500mm, except for interchangeable parts produced, based on the structural characteristics, coordinated dimensions can be used. Coordinated dimensions are based on the standard dimension of one component as the base number, and the processing of one component is carried out according to public tolerance levels. Single parts and small batch production coordinated components are designed by personnel according to production and use conditions.
(1) General Requirements for Coordinated Dimensions

items: First, interchangeable parts production uses coordinated dimensions, and the coordinated result should satisfy the combined dimensions;

Generally, the selected standard tool, and can reach the tolerance level of the multi-hole component (mostly holes) as the first processing work, giving it an easy-to-reach public tolerance "selected dimension does not exceed tolerance";

Coordinated dimensions (mostly shafts) are dimensioned according to the determined combined dimensions. All coordinated component public dimensions should use interchangeable production single component public dimensions. The coordinated component's tolerance and limit dimensions should be added to the processing work's actual dimension as the base to determine;
Coordinated dimensions do not involve form and position tolerances, surface structure, etc., should not reduce the requirements for coordinated dimensions on both sides;
Measurement should pay attention to accuracy, shape position deviation of measurement points.

sections.text: (2) Notes on Coordinated Dimensions in Drawings

Cylindrical Gear Meshing - Gear - Worm - Worm Gear Meshing Method

When a vertical cylindrical gear is meshed with a worm on an inclined plane, the contact line in the middle of the tooth surface is a circular arc. As shown in Figure 8 (12), the tooth line does not pass through the center of the circular arc. When a vertical cylindrical gear is meshed with a worm, the tooth line does not pass through the center, and the tooth line is inclined at an angle to the axis. When meshing with a worm in the same plane, the tooth line of one gear is inclined at an angle, and the tooth line of the other gear is used for real line control. Another type of worm gear is controlled by the inclined part of the worm, which is not shown in Figure 12, Figure 13, and Figure 15. In the schematic diagram, when the cutting plane does not pass through the tooth line of the worm gear, it is controlled by a line perpendicular to the cutting plane.

17 Dynamic Seal Ring Representation Method (Extracted from GB/T 4459.8～9—2009)

This standard is mainly applicable to assembly drawings that do not require detailed representation of the shape and structure of the rotating shaft seal ring. In complex rotating shaft seal ring and rubber anti-extrusion ring, according to the standard prescribed seal ring symbols, shaft shape and line control are used. This standard specifies simplified drawing methods and prescribed drawing methods. Simplified drawing methods can use the general method (GB/T 4459.8) or symbol method (GB/T 4459.9). In a drawing, generally only one method or symbol method is used. On the front view, use the simplified method to control the seal ring—a small section symbol; when the seal ring is drawn in detail, the fixed drawing method can be used to draw the seal ring, with metal skeleton frame inserted into the element on the front view symbol or omitted, as shown in Figures 2-1-12 and 2-1-13.

Short Axis Method (短轴法):
(1) Use the known major axis ab as the diameter of the circle, and use the minor axis cd as the diameter of the circle, draw two concentric circles with center o
(2) Draw any number of radii, and intersect the two circles at points 1, 2, 3, 4, etc.
(3) Connect points ae, be, cd, bd and extend them, with a, b as the center, ab as the semi-major axis of each circle, and the intersection points 1, 2, 3, 4 on the circle

(1) Pass through the focus point, work with the straight line mm perpendicular to the axis, and intersect with the axis at point o

(3) With point a on the directrix, draw a line perpendicular to the axis to intersect the perpendicular line at point 1, 1', II, II', III, III', etc.
(4) Use the corresponding points on each point to connect the smooth curve

items: Geometric accuracy, see Figure 2-22.
Processing and assembly process requirements, which are specified to ensure product quality and improve process requirements.

sections.text: ⑤ Other Requirements
The standard shall specify the general content of the following nine aspects as required by the specific product.

items: Requirements for materials,毛皮, heat treatment (such as electromagnetic parameters, chemical composition, moisture, hardness, magnetic properties, etc.).
Dimensional deviations, shapes and surface finish tolerances shown in the drawing.
Requirements for related structural elements (such as chamfers, bevels, dimensions, etc.).
Requirements for surface finish of parts and components (such as coating, plating, surface finish, etc.).
Appearance, surface finish and other structural element special requirements.
Requirements for calibration, adjustment and sealing.
Requirements for product performance, component performance and measurement (such as noise, vibration, automation, safety, etc.).
Test conditions and methods.
Other instructions.

When describing with "Technical Requirements" as the title, only one condition is necessary, but not all standards are listed. Do not use "Note" instead of "Technical Requirements"; "Technical Requirements" is "Technical Conditions" in the "Technical Conditions" section.
